profile.name: 二进制 STL 写入器
profile.description: 用于将由三角形或四边形顶点构成的三维对象导出为二进制 STL 文件的写出工具，常用于三维模型交换、数控加工和 3D 打印前的数据准备。
profile.description_en: A file-writing utility that exports 3D objects made of triangular or quadrilateral vertices to binary STL files, commonly used for 3D model exchange, CAM workflows, and 3D printing preparation.
